label: Rival: something is its own subsistent being and is not INFINITE_1
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by the thin view of existence (a thing's being its own existence settles nothing about how much it is) and by accounts of finite self-existent things: something whose act of being is its essence is not infinite. The replacement account is that limitation comes from what a thing is, not from its essence receiving being; the formal statement does not express that account. It is the exact negation of STMT-SUBSISTENT-BEING-IS-INFINITE on the same carrier. It does not say that nothing is infinite.
